title: An afternoon of relaxation
text: Wonderful Experience! We did it as a couple, it was a gift and I even blew out candles, totally unplanned. That is thanks to the hostess Stefi and also to Giusseppe who were our masters on board. The ride was beautiful, the food and the service were fantastic! A unique moment of relaxation, silence and calm. Highly recommended 🌟🌟
author: carolina_remorini

title: My wife and I enjoyed a...
text: My wife and I enjoyed a wonderful and relaxing evening, first sailing in the harbor and then dining on the sailboat when it returned to the pier. Truly romantic! And the operator was very accommodating of our dietary restrictions.
author: Alexander_P

title: Nice experience, good dinner and Barcelona in the background
text:
A nice gift for a nice experience.
Everything was great, hosts Steffi and Christian 10.
Dinner was exquisite, and the setting unique. We didn't do the sailboat ride for personal reasons.
Highly recommended
author: MaryCarmenC20

title: Special dinner and brilliant walk
text:
We have a romantic dinner, with some good starters and paella as main. We were in a quiet and beautiful Mood! 
The crew very friendly and with positive energy.
Un 10/10
If you want to have a special dinner we recommend it. 
And the night walk we could see the Barcelona skyline differently and very nicely.
author: M5952DAjessican
